rounds.text: GE Power India Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at a P/E of just 10.19x against a sector benchmark of 27.45x [E6], while offering an EV/EBITDA of 7.14x compared to the sector's 18.02x [E11]. The business displays elite profitability, generating an extraordinary ROCE of 65.69% against a sector benchmark of 18.2% [E10] and an ROE of 58.3% [E9]. Operational execution is exceptional, highlighted by operating margins surging to 21% in March 2026—a 38 percentage point increase over three years [E30]—alongside pristine financial health reflected in a near-zero debt-to-equity ratio of 0.03x [E38] and robust cash conversion of 1.99x [E34]. Furthermore, intrinsic value derived from a discounted cash flow model sits at Rs 1430 per share, offering a substantial margin of safety of 45.0% over the current market price [E45, E46]. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor compounded sales growth of -18% over the past 5 years [E15, E64] and high debtors of 219 days [E66].
